hypothesis: The exact-C outcome model may be systematically under- or over-dispersed out of time. A single fixed amplitude around the immediately preceding completed R-season mean can improve Brier score while preserving ranking, row independence, and the exact parent on F.

required_each_year: R point gain >= 50 raw score points
